reviewed_by: Claude review of importing the Linux-only secretstorage module lazily
reason: vault_probe.py and credentials.py imported secretstorage at module scope, but keyring installs that Linux-only dependency only on Linux, so importing nebula.v3 on macOS or Windows died inside nebula/v3/__init__.py -> domain -> diagnostics -> diagnostic_sensitive -> vault_probe with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'secretstorage'. CI's macOS job is gated on a native test selection, so nothing has run it since #374 introduced the import; the first diff to select native tests (the diagnostics log-tolerance branch) failed collection there. Both modules now import secretstorage inside the SecretService code paths, which run only when keyring selects that backend, and secret_service_state() already routes caught failures through on_caught, so a missing dependency reads as an unavailable vault. tests/v3/test_credentials.py adds two tests that fail on origin/main: one runs a subprocess with a meta-path finder that blocks secretstorage and imports nebula.v3.credentials and nebula.v3.vault_probe, the other pins that the Linux probe reports 'unavailable' with an ImportError instead of raising. The existing Linux vault tests monkeypatch attributes on the same module object and still pass, because a function-level import resolves through sys.modules. The native selection is present only to run the macOS job, which is where this fix has to be proven: it collects tests/v3/test_sandbox.py under -k macos, the collection that was failing.
exclusions: No frontend or Rust source change: the selected native test is the cheapest one that makes CI run the macOS job at all, and its Rust behaviour is unrelated and unchanged. No Playwright: src/nebula/v3/** matches the catch-all core-api rule, but no request, response, or rendered surface changes -- on Linux, where every browser suite runs, the import resolves exactly as before. No screenshot baselines for the same reason. tests/v3/test_diagnostics.py and test_diagnostic_sensitive.py are excluded because diagnostic_sensitive.py only re-exports vault_state and is untouched; both were run locally and pass. The two compaction tests in tests/v3/test_orchestration.py remain red on origin/main for the reason recorded in earlier receipts and are unrelated.
